name: bloch-reorg-safe-indexer
description: Reference reorg-safe address/UTXO/history indexer for Bloch. SCAFFOLD, unaudited, pre-production. Testnet-only reference.
_engines_note: Node >=21 is required, not >=18: recovering an oversized legacy satoshi literal exactly uses the JSON.parse reviver's source-text access (V8 10.9 / Node 21). On 18-20 that path throws instead of returning a rounded amount, which is the correct failure but is still a failure. See src/sats.ts and docs/specs/BLOCH-SATOSHI-ENCODING.md.
